criteria.title: Provider registry interface and built-in catalogs exist
criteria.assertion: Bahia exposes a voice provider registry interface and registers ElevenLabs, Azure Speech, OpenAI TTS, and local CLI providers.
criteria.expected_result: Default registry returns stable provider IDs and capability payloads for all four providers.

criteria.title: Voice metadata supports customization UX
criteria.assertion: Provider voices include metadata needed by Voice Studio: language, gender, style tags, provider, supported models, and display names.
criteria.expected_result: ElevenLabs and other built-in voices enumerate non-empty metadata suitable for filtering and display.

criteria.title: Provider capabilities are cached safely
criteria.assertion: Registry capability queries cache provider snapshots and do not leak caller mutations back into the cache.
criteria.expected_result: Repeated capability calls hit the provider once while cache is fresh, and returned snapshots are defensive copies.

criteria.title: SoulVoiceSpec resolution uses domain voice specs
criteria.assertion: Registry resolution accepts domain.SoulVoiceSpec and domain.SoulVoicePersonaSpec, resolves provider-specific voice IDs, preserves persona metadata, and rejects explicit missing voices.
criteria.expected_result: An ElevenLabs SoulVoiceSpec resolves to the Adam voice and persona metadata; an unknown explicit provider voice returns ErrVoiceNotFound.
